figures.name: Leonardo da Vinci
figures.descriptionText: Artist, inventor, scientist, polymath, and one of the defining minds of the Renaissance.

figures.name: Ada Lovelace
figures.descriptionText: Known for early work on Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine and ideas about computing.

figures.name: Elizabeth II
figures.descriptionText: Former Queen of the United Kingdom.

figures.name: Michael Jackson
figures.descriptionText: A globally influential performer whose music, dance, and videos reshaped popular culture.

figures.name: Cleopatra VII
figures.descriptionText: Last active ruler of Ptolemaic Egypt, known for her political alliances with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony.

figures.name: Wu Zetian
figures.descriptionText: The only woman to formally rule China as emperor, governing during the Zhou dynasty established within the Tang period.

figures.name: Elizabeth I
figures.descriptionText: Queen of England and Ireland whose reign saw major cultural, political, and maritime developments.

figures.name: Marie Curie
figures.descriptionText: Physicist and chemist whose pioneering research on radioactivity earned her two Nobel Prizes.

figures.name: Vincent van Gogh
figures.descriptionText: Vincent Willem van Gogh was a Dutch Post-Impressionist painter who is among the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art. In just over a decade he created about 2,100 artworks, including around 860 oil paintings, most of them in the last two years of his life.
